title: Repost: a common kingfisher's preening session

scenes.body: Common kingfishers dig nest tunnels into steep banks, usually 15 to 30 cm long. Both parents dig.

scenes.headline: Filmed by Lennart Hessel
scenes.body: Licence: CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

caption:
Two minutes of maintenance, ten seconds of glory.

Common kingfishers hunt from a perch, dive for small fish and fly straight back out. Fish make up about 60-67% of their diet.

Source: Animal Diversity Web.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Aggregator-repost demo: near-whole CC clip, prominent credit, one added fact. Real format is high-risk with third-party footage (unoriginal/copyright); only OK with our own or CC-licensed media plus added context, as here.
